title: Ensure sustained mailbox admission pressure cannot indefinitely starve health detection
outcome: Ensure sustained mailbox admission pressure cannot indefinitely starve health detection
acceptance: Define and implement a bounded liveness policy that survives ordinary mailbox429 pressure but detects a black-holed peer under sustained mailbox retries.
Keep the four-in-flight resource bound or explicitly reviewed replacement; pressure never stamps success or silently resets backoff.
A controlled regression distinguishes a healthy congested link from a dead peer while mailbox calls occupy available admission.
